name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app, installed CopilotKit, and wired up the runtime and frontend files exactly as the quickstart specifies. The dev server started and the CopilotKit runtime endpoint demonstrably works: `GET /api/copilotkit/info` returned a valid JSON payload showing runtime version `1.71.1`, the `BuiltInAgent` as default, and its capabilities. However, the frontend page at `/` never responded to curl (empty response), and the dev server process kept dying, likely due to sandbox memory constraints—the earlier `npm run build` was killed with exit code 137 (OOM). Without a real `OPENAI_API_KEY` in the environment, I had to use a dummy key, so even if the page loaded, the chat endpoint would fail authentication. The runtime is up, but I could not verify the full end-to-end “working copilot endpoint” because the frontend would not compile and serve stably.

installed.evidence: added 1162 packages, and audited 1528 packages in 2m
